2. The MACPS envisages merely placement in the immediate next higher level in the hierarchy of the Pay Matrix as given in PART-A of Schedule of the CCS (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016. Thus, the level at the time of financial upgradation under the MACPS can, in certain cases where regular promotion is not between two successive Pay Levels, be lower than what is available at the time of regular promotion.
